statement: Pinned Dolphin's Classic Controller emulator initializes a 16-byte calibration structure at extension register 0xA40020: two sticks' X/Y max/min/center fields, two trigger-neutral values, and two checksum bytes. Dolphin fills only 0x20-0x2F; its distinct 0x30-0x3F field is zeroed on reset. This conflicts with rnconrad's duplicated template at 0x20 and 0x30 and does not establish retail or Classic Pro factory layout.

applicability.revision: Emulator or Linux/SDL host source behavior; retail revision not measured
applicability.scope: Dolphin Extension.h:78-80, Extension.cpp:124-127, Classic.cpp:142-175. No calibration mirror at 0x30 in Dolphin's emulator reset. WiiBrew Classic subpage cross-reference: wii-gap-wiibrew-classic-power-on-center documents consumer center calibration, not retail 0x20/0x30 bytes or additive checksum; emulator conflict with rnconrad remains.
